cases.title: 120 in patio board rows
cases.description: A 10 ft coverage with 5½ in actual board faces and ⅛ in gaps; row length matches 12 ft stock.
cases.verification: 22 rows use 21 full 5.5 in faces, 21 gaps at 0.125 in, and a 1.875 in final ripped face: 21×5.5+21×0.125+1.875=120 in. Waste changes the purchase count, not the physical row coordinates.

cases.title: 95 in porch; stock shorter than row
cases.description: A 95 in coverage, 10 ft long row, 5½ in faces, ¼ in gaps, using 8 ft supplier stock. The result does not determine butt-joint placement.
cases.verification: 17 rows produce 16×5.5+16×0.25+3=95 in. Each 120 in row requires at least two 96 in stock pieces mathematically; the 38-piece conservative quote is NOT a buildable seam/joist layout.

cases.title: 8 ft reference; 1½ in ridge board
cases.description: A 96 in centerline run at 6:12 with half the 1.5 in ridge thickness removed, 12 in horizontal overhang, 3 in seat.
cases.verification: The horizontal run is 96−1.5/2=95.25 in, rise is 95.25×6/12=47.625 in and slope length is hypot(95.25,47.625). Seat notch normal depth is 3×sin(arctan(6/12))≈1.341641 in; bearing and structural limits need independent review.

cases.title: 10 ft run; shallower 4:12 roof
cases.description: A 120 in horizontal run at 4:12 with no ridge board, 18 in horizontal eave overhang, 7¼ in measured stock depth and 3½ in horizontal seat.
cases.verification: At 4:12, the rise is 120/3=40 in and roof-line length is hypot(120,40). The 3.5 in seat reference removes 3.5×sin(arctan(1/3))≈1.106797 in normal depth; this is not a code-rated rafter design.

cases.title: 105 in rise; 14 uniform risers
cases.description: A reference stair flight rising 105 in in 14 risers, with 13 independent 10 in horizontal treads, 11¼ in stock depth and 1½ in tread thickness.
cases.verification: The step rise is 105÷14=7.5 in, flight run=(14−1)×10=130 in, and a 10 in tread with 7.5 in rise cuts 7.5×10/hypot(7.5,10)=6 in into the normal section, leaving 11.25−6=5.25 in nominal throat. Structural approval is excluded.

cases.title: 96 in rise; 13 risers and thicker finish
cases.description: A 96 in finished rise, 13 risers, 10½ in run per tread, 1¼ in tread surface thickness and ¼ in lower-floor finish allowance.
cases.verification: The riser is 96÷13≈7.384615 in; only 12 independent treads contribute to the 126 in run. Nominal bottom reference is 96/13−1.25+0.25≈6.384615 in. Bottom-finish adjustment and structural bearing must be measured separately.
